g.text: Graph revision AD - ga_front: Keys: 1000 x 600 x 800 mm envelope - the node size_mm (study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)); the duty section 2 states no envelope - the node governs (hold W12)
Graph revision AD - ga_front: RCA/etch wet bench per the node equipment list: SC1 and SC2 baths 10 L at 80 C with immersion heater envelopes, DHF etch bath at ambient, DIW rinse bay

Graph revision AD - ga_front: Wetted material per duty section 3: PVC-U per AQS-STD-002 M1/M2, no metal wetted part; above 60 C the thermoplastic is CPVC - the node equipment rows give the 80 C bath temperatures, so SC1/SC2 are CPVC
Graph revision AD - ga_front: The node equipment rows name PP tanks; the duty selection governs (plan rule 5; hold W12)
